qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the cross member to body mounting bolts?
What torque should I use for the rubber mounts to cross member or transmission?
What is the torque specification for the support tube to engine subframe on the E36?
What torque specification applies to the rubber mounts to carrier pipe?
Which transmission mount components use the same 21 Nm torque specification?
qa_pairs.answer: Cross member to body, rubber mounts to cross member or transmission, rubber mounts to carrier pipe, and carrier plate all use 21 Nm

qa_pairs.question: What vehicle types are covered by the transmission mount specifications in section 24.71?
qa_pairs.answer: All vehicle types for most specifications, with specific E36 specifications for support tube to engine subframe, rubber mounts to carrier pipe, and carrier plate

qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the carrier plate?
Which transmission mount component has the highest torque specification?
qa_pairs.answer: The support tube to engine subframe at 42 Nm

qa_pairs.question: How many transmission mount components are listed in section 24.71?
qa_pairs.answer: Five components are listed: cross member to body, rubber mounts to cross member or transmission, support tube to engine subframe, rubber mounts to carrier pipe, and carrier plate
